plan.summary: Fix the Outbound MessageSenderService worker-wedge: replace HttpClient.Timeout=Infinite with a FINITE backstop (WapCrmSendClient + WapCrmTemplateClient) so a hung cxapi POST can never freeze the single-threaded sender, and add a periodic staleness-gated 'posting' recovery sweep so a stranded run heals to 'ambiguous' without a manual service restart.
plan.q_intent: bir fix lazim diyordun (worker-wedge). Kapsam: +Dayaniklilik (finite HttpClient.Timeout + periyodik staleness-gated posting sweep). Medipol run'i 4 saat dondu, manuel restart gerekti.
plan.interview_notes: Q chose '+Dayaniklilik' scope: finite HttpClient.Timeout backstop AND periodic posting sweep. The 'sending' reset stays startup-only (no safe staleness gate; would race a live send) — Q-confirmed. Root cause confirmed: Program.cs:224 http.Timeout=Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan; the per-attempt 10s linked CTS was the sole bound and failed once on a stuck socket -> ProcessQueue await never returned -> _isProcessing stuck -> 4h wedge. DB path is bounded by Npgsql defaults so it cannot cause a multi-hour hang.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WapCrmSendClient + WapCrmTemplateClient HttpClient.Timeout is FINITE (= TimeoutMs + buffer, buffer floored at 1s), never Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan, so no SendAsync can hang past the backstop.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Program.cs:224/253 now use TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(opts.HttpClientBackstopMs); HttpClientBackstopMs = TimeoutMs + Math.Max(buffer,1000) > TimeoutMs so the per-attempt CTS still fires first. Build PASS.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A stranded 'posting' row recovers to 'ambiguous' WITHOUT a service restart, via a periodic sweep that runs while the worker is up.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: MessageSenderService.TryRecoverStrandedAsync calls the existing staleness-gated SweepStrandedPostingAsync every RecoverySweepIntervalMs (default 2min), runs BEFORE the _isProcessing guard, own _isSweeping guard + throttle.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The periodic sweep is safe to run concurrently with active sends (never touches an in-flight POST) and the 'sending' reset is NOT made periodic.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: SweepStrandedPostingAsync is staleness-gated (last_attempt_at < now - StalePostingMinutes), so an in-flight POST (<StalePostingMinutes old) is never swept. ResetStrandedCxapiSendingAsync remains startup-only.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shared change is additive (no breaking change); full solution builds with 0 errors.
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Only new optional properties added to WapCrmSendOptions/WapCrmTemplateOptions; full solution build 0 Error / 42 pre-existing warnings.

files_changed.change: WapCrmSendClient + WapCrmTemplateClient HttpClient.Timeout: Infinite -> finite opts.HttpClientBackstopMs; comment fix

+_isSweeping/_lastSweepTicks fields; StartAsync stamps _lastSweepTicks; ProcessQueue calls TryRecoverStrandedAsync before the send interlock; new TryRecoverStrandedAsync (throttled, guarded, staleness-gated posting sweep)
WapCrmSendOptions += HttpClientBackstopBufferMs + HttpClientBackstopMs (additive); TimeoutMs doc updated
WapCrmTemplateOptions += HttpClientBackstopBufferMs + HttpClientBackstopMs (additive); TimeoutMs doc updated

verification_questions.question: Does the finite HttpClient.Timeout backstop ever pre-empt a legitimate slow-but-valid cxapi response, masking the intended per-attempt CTS behaviour?
Can the periodic posting sweep race an in-flight POST and incorrectly mark a still-sending message 'ambiguous'?
If TryRecoverStrandedAsync throws or the DB is unreachable, can it crash the async-void ProcessQueue worker or leave _isSweeping stuck at 1?

non_goals: Changing the per-attempt CTS timeout value
A watchdog that abandons a hung await (the finite HttpClient.Timeout prevents the hang at source)
intentional_exclusions: No config added to appsettings (code defaults: backstop=TimeoutMs+5000, sweep interval=120000ms)

try_catch_locations: MessageSenderService.TryRecoverStrandedAsync: typed OperationCanceledException + NpgsqlException + a documented async-void boundary Exception safety net; finally resets _isSweeping
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: A failed sweep is logged (SystemError) and retried next interval; the row stays safely 'posting' until then. The async-void Exception catch logs rather than swallows silently. HttpClient.Timeout firing surfaces as the existing 'ambiguous' outcome path (logged).

aha_moments.user_pain: A single hung cxapi POST froze ALL outbound sends for 4 hours and only a manual service restart fixed it.
aha_moments.suggestion: Finite HttpClient.Timeout backstop so a stuck socket can never wedge the single-threaded sender.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Sends keep flowing for every tenant even when one socket hangs — the wedge simply cannot happen anymore.

aha_moments.user_pain: Stranded 'posting'/'sending' rows only recovered on the next process restart, so a frozen run stayed frozen until someone noticed.
aha_moments.suggestion: Periodic staleness-gated posting sweep while the worker is up.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A stranded run self-heals to 'ambiguous' within minutes — the operator never has to restart the service.

aha_moments.user_pain: Ops had no signal that a run was wedged vs. just slow.
aha_moments.suggestion: Log a SystemWarn each time the periodic sweep recovers stranded broadcasts.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The log line '[cxapi-send] periodic recovery swept N ...' tells support exactly what self-healed and when.

aha_moments.user_pain: After a deploy mid-send, the next run could stall behind a stuck connection.
aha_moments.suggestion: Backstop > per-attempt CTS so normal sends are unaffected but a stuck one resolves in ~15s to 'ambiguous'.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A bad socket now costs ~15s, not 4 hours.

aha_moments.user_pain: The same Infinite-timeout bug also sat in the template-list client (preview/confirm path).
aha_moments.suggestion: Apply the finite backstop to WapCrmTemplateClient too.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Neither the send loop nor the template fetch can hang indefinitely — the whole cxapi surface is bounded.

verdict.raw_text: iter0 FAIL (CQ5 bare catch(Exception); CQ11 db-sync evidence; CQ12 INV code) -> iter1 fixes: sweep moved inside the _isProcessing guard (covered by existing typed catches, no new catch(Exception)), removed _isSweeping, NpgsqlException log carries INV-OB-065, summary states no schema change -> Codex PASS 12/12 CQ + 3/3 CoVe.
